arguments.question: For ANET, MU, META and NVDA, examine the latest available company filings/results and identify, separately for each, the next 21/63-session fundamental catalysts and downside drivers. Provide dated operational/financial facts, clarify fiscal-period comparability, and state whether available evidence supports a simple explicit EPS/multiple scenario sensitivity; for QQQ, assess dated sponsor profile/holdings look-through rather than corporate earnings. Stop after the latest material filing/result and at most one primary supporting document per issuer; do not infer consensus.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether any company-specific evidence differentiates a 21/63-session thesis from sector and broad-market movement, and whether scenario valuation is feasible.
